scope: Address the source-only peer findings for screenshot fixture/content resolution and emulation observation. No runtime, build, browser, database, inventory, or case-status changes.

findings_addressed.finding: Screenshot fixture did not guarantee below-fold content.
findings_addressed.resolution: Changed the proposed target to the public Artificial intelligence article on Wikipedia. The procedure now requires the page to scroll, verifies its top heading and below-fold References landmark by scrolling, and requires full-page image height to exceed the viewport. If any condition is absent at execution time, the step stops and records the branch unavailable; it cannot silently skip the below-fold proof.
evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:155-204 (Page.getLayoutMetrics content size and viewport capture sizing)

findings_addressed.finding: Cloud screenshot result may return a file ID without a URL, leaving no executable pixel-inspection route.
findings_addressed.resolution: Added the existing Files → Captures route: captures are indexed for the current page, the capture card's open action opens the canonical frontend file viewer by file_id. If the viewer cannot resolve the returned ID, the procedure explicitly leaves content inspection unavailable and does not pass from metadata.
evidence: src/lib/screenshot/persist.ts:45-67,157-182 (cloud image reference and screenshot saved/indexed flow)

findings_addressed.finding: Chrome DevTools on the extension-debugger-owned tab can detach the extension debugger, making clear take its unattached success branch.
findings_addressed.resolution: Removed DevTools inspection. Emulation and clear procedures now use cdp_full_page_screenshot on the same owned tab with full_page=false. This source-supported same-extension CDP route reads Page.getLayoutMetrics for cssLayoutViewport client width/height and returns the captured viewport pixels. The procedure requires the owned attachment ID to be present immediately before clear and requires dimensions/pixels to return to baseline after clear.
evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:155-204 (same-handler layout viewport measurement and screenshot capture)
src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:562-623 (emulation and clear commands; unattached clear short-circuit)

findings_addressed.finding: No source-supported, noncompeting route reads actual UA, DPR, and matchMedia state while preserving the debugger attachment.
findings_addressed.resolution: Source review found no such route. Procedures explicitly leave UA, DPR, and media-query readback/restoration unresolved and never infer them from {ok:true}. No invented endpoint or DevTools workaround was added.
evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:562-623 (writes metrics/UA override and clear, but returns no page-state values)
src/lib/tools/handlers/extract.ts:590-605 (existing DPR probe uses chrome.scripting.executeScript, but its caller is not an existing manual CDP observation control)
src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:155-204 (available source-backed viewport and pixel measurements)

preserved: Exact inventory modes and control IDs remain unchanged: screenshot/PDF member and admin; emulate/clear admin only.
Dispatcher admin, Ask/Act, optional-permission denial, guest applicability, and agent routing remain unverified; manual Tools runner is not evidence for those gates.
Warm and extension-reload passes, attached-tabs baselines, unique owned delta checks, and exact-owned cleanup remain required.
No runtime promotion, test, browser, build, or database activity occurred.

round2_correction.finding: The shared setup created a Wikipedia target while the PDF procedure named example.org, and shared cleanup also hardcoded example.org.
round2_correction.resolution: The PDF positive steps and preconditions now name the exact owned Wikipedia fixture. Shared cleanup closes the exact owned tab established for that pass by its recorded ID; it no longer names example.org. The same tall public fixture is consistently used across cases.
evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:498-524 (PDF consumes the selected owned tab and returns pdf_base64/decoded byte_length)
preserved_gaps: UA, DPR, and matchMedia observation remain explicitly unverified.
Manual-runner dispatcher, permission, admin, and agent-routing gaps remain unchanged.
